entities.name: Nina Stojiljković
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nina Stojiljković is a Serbian-French professional volleyball player of the France women's national volleyball team. Stojiljković won with the national team European Golden League, FIVB Challenger Cup and was part of the team when it made its Olympic debut.
